children: Libya's oil production has returned to normal levels after a limited impact from the shutdown of three oil fields due to protests on Tuesday, National Oil Corporation Chairman Massoud Suleman told Reuters on Wednesday.
Suleman said conditions were currently normal and he doesn't anticipate further shutdowns.

Members of the security force charged with protecting Libya's oil sector had closed a valve on the main Hamada-Zawiya crude-loading pipeline, completely halting production at the Hamada, Tahara and NC5 fields.
